translations.bsb: The following creatures that move along the ground are unclean for you: the mole, the mouse, any kind of great lizard,
translations.kjv: These also shall be unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise after his kind,
translations.asv: And these are they which are unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth: the weasel, and the mouse, and the great lizard after its kind,
